claim_status_vocabulary.EXACT_UNDER_ASSUMPTIONS: Algebraic identity or theorem proved under the record's explicit assumptions.
claim_status_vocabulary.MODEL_EXACT_UNDER_DECLARATION: Exact result inside the displayed declared model, not a universal physical law.
claim_status_vocabulary.PROSPECTIVE_DESIGN_OBLIGATION: Required future analytical or teaching record; not implemented framework behaviour.
claim_status_vocabulary.INSTITUTIONAL_HYPOTHESIS: Falsifiable institutional proposition; not a physical theorem or universal social effect.
claim_status_vocabulary.MANDATORY_NONCLAIM: Interpretation or programme route explicitly prohibited.

records.title: Exact subset synthesis and Möbius inversion
records.statement: For a complete fixed Boolean subset protocol, e = Z iota, iota = M e, and M = Z^-1.
assumptions: common boundary, units, baseline, clocks, and protocol identity
records.proof_placement: Programme review §5; Part VI.14 proof teaching
records.example_placement: Programme review §5 two-action reconstruction; Part VI.14 nonzero-baseline pump case
falsifiers: missing arbitrary black-box subset entry
changed protocol identity
inconsistent subset ordering
limitations: requires the complete finite table unless separate structure supplies proved information

records.title: Mixed finite differences and empty-set separation
records.statement: Every nonempty raw interaction coefficient is the corresponding Boolean mixed finite difference at the empty set; raw and normalized empty coordinates remain distinct.
assumptions: normalization, when used, subtracts the same E(empty) from all outcomes
records.proof_placement: Programme review §6; Part VI.14
records.example_placement: Programme review §6 baseline 10 pair example; Part VI.14
falsifiers: setting raw I(empty) to zero when E(empty) is nonzero
mixing normalized and raw synthesis equations
limitations: Boolean differences are finite protocol contrasts

records.title: Exact omitted-interaction accounting error
records.statement: The order-k reconstruction error for E(S) is exactly the sum of coefficients I(T) with T subset S and order greater than k.
records.proof_placement: Programme review §7; Part VI.14
records.example_placement: Pure triple with zero singleton and pair coefficients
falsifiers: pure-triple table reconstructed exactly by a pair-only ledger
displayed residual differs from the signed omitted sum
limitations: signed omitted terms can cancel

records.title: Raw correction locality
records.statement: Changing one raw E(Q) by delta changes I(S) by (-1)^(|S|-|Q|) delta exactly when Q is a subset of S and by zero otherwise.
assumptions: raw rather than normalized empty convention
records.proof_placement: Programme review §8; Part VI.15
records.example_placement: Upward-cone table including Q = empty
falsifiers: coefficient outside the upward cone changes under the stated single-entry edit
empty-set alternating signs fail
limitations: operational revalidation may be wider than the Boolean cone

records.title: Exact inversion, adjoint sensitivity, and estimation separation
records.statement: M e, J* r, and a weighted or regularized estimate are different maps with different assumptions and meanings.
assumptions: each map declares its domain and codomain
estimator weights, regularization, and invertibility are explicit
records.proof_placement: Programme review §9; Part VII.12
records.example_placement: Weighted adjoint comparison and scalar Tikhonov counterexample
falsifiers: metric change leaves a generally metric-dependent adjoint unchanged without special structure
regularized scalar estimate equals the unregularized inverse for the displayed counterexample
replacement_mapping: REPLACE:VII.12:Joint Effects and O3 Across a Route
limitations: sensitivity and estimates inherit model, metric, noise, and identifiability limits

records.title: Linear coordinate conjugacy and spectrum
records.statement: For fixed invertible Z, A_I = M A_E Z = Z^-1 A_E Z and A_I has the same spectrum and Jordan structure as A_E.
assumptions: e is a genuine shared time-dependent state
action set, ordering, boundary, and clocks remain fixed
records.proof_placement: Programme review §10.1; Part VI.15
records.example_placement: Stable rotation-decay under a Boolean coordinate transform
falsifiers: different characteristic polynomials under the stated similarity
singular or changing Z
exclusions: incomplete counterfactual table treated as a dynamic state
limitations: filters, projections, clipping, and changing bases are not similarity transformations

records.title: Nonlinear Jacobian and flow conjugacy
records.statement: For g(iota) = M f(Z iota), Dg = M Df Z at corresponding states and Phi_I^t = M Phi_E^t Z when the flow exists uniquely.
assumptions: f differentiable for the Jacobian result
existence and uniqueness for the flow result
records.proof_placement: Programme review §10.2; Part VI.15
records.example_placement: Corresponding equilibria, periodic orbit, and changing-coordinate refusal case
falsifiers: corresponding flow identity fails under the stated fixed coordinates
nondifferentiable switch used for a Jacobian claim
exclusions: state-dependent coordinate theorem without extra terms
limitations: time-dependent coordinate maps require additional derivative terms

records.title: Representation versus feedback mechanism
records.statement: Delta(t) = P exp(Kt) J - exp(At) tests whether an augmented correction channel changes physical dynamics; PK^2J = A^2 + BC identifies the second-order path.
assumptions: embedding J and projection P fixed
records.proof_placement: Programme review §11; Part VIII.16
records.example_placement: BC nonzero second-order feedback influence and longer BD^mC path
falsifiers: Delta(t) remains zero for all t despite a claimed changed physical trajectory
unmatched initial states or clocks
exclusions: mere coordinate visibility treated as a mechanism
physical availability or authorization inferred from matrix coupling
limitations: a nonlinear system requires an appropriate nonlinear comparison

records.title: Typed product state
records.statement: Prospective analysis separates X_physical, X_scientific, and X_correction in a typed Cartesian product.
assumptions: each factor has declared types and ownership
prospective fields are not represented as implemented
records.proof_placement: Definition in programme review §12; Part VIII.2
records.example_placement: Refrigerator calibration history with separate physical, scientific, and correction records
prerequisites: accepted I-7 state and history boundary
falsifiers: one untyped field silently carries incompatible meanings
product called a direct sum without vector-space declarations
exclusions: implemented I-7 or I-8 schema claim
replacement_mapping: REPLACE:VIII.2:Complete State, Histories, and Evaluation Horizons
limitations: analytical design discipline only

records.title: Hidden correction channel and memory kernel
records.statement: Eliminating c from the declared linear coupled system yields initial forcing B exp(Dt)c(0) and memory kernel K(t) = B exp(Dt) C.
records.proof_placement: Programme review §13; Part VIII.13
records.example_placement: Thermostat hidden-state memory
falsifiers: variation-of-constants substitution omits the initial forcing
block dimensions are incompatible
exclusions: Markov claim for the reduced visible state
limitations: nonlinear, stochastic, and time-varying systems require separate derivations

records.title: Continuous two-channel feedback regimes
records.statement: For p(lambda) = lambda^2 + (a+d)lambda + (ad+bk), asymptotic stability holds exactly when a+d > 0 and ad+bk > 0, with discriminant separating real and oscillatory regimes.
assumptions: declared real two-channel linear time-invariant model
named observable and initial condition for overshoot
declared norm and tolerance for recovery
records.proof_placement: Programme review §14; Part VIII.15
records.example_placement: Temperature correction with real decay, damped oscillation, boundary persistence, and instability cases
falsifiers: characteristic polynomial mismatch
declared stable case has a root with nonnegative real part
overshoot claimed without observable and initial condition
limitations: saturation, switching, noise, and nonlinear coupling require separate analysis

records.title: Discrete delay sensitivity
records.statement: The no-delay scalar controller is stable for 0 < kappa < 2; the one-step delayed recurrence is stable for 0 < kappa < 1 and oscillatory with decay for 1/4 < kappa < 1.
assumptions: one exact discrete delay for the delayed case
records.proof_placement: Programme review §15; Part VIII.10
records.example_placement: Weekly inventory overcorrection
falsifiers: characteristic roots violate the stated unit-circle regimes
longer delay presented as the one-step theorem
replacement_mapping: REPLACE:VIII.10:Delay, Causal Reach, and Observation Age
limitations: longer, fractional, distributed, and state-dependent delays need separate analysis

records.title: Uncorrected-corrected dynamic diagnostic
records.statement: A future frozen comparison reports dynamics, equilibrium, eigenvalues or roots, damping, period, peak overshoot, recovery time, accumulated correction action or work, delay sensitivity, observability, and exact feedback influence.
assumptions: matched initial states, clocks, boundaries, units, and observables
physical work uses declared conjugate variables, signs, units, and boundary
records.proof_placement: Diagnostic definition and exact subresults in programme review §16; Part VIII.16
records.example_placement: Refrigeration controller before-after comparison
falsifiers: comparison changes more than the declared correction mechanism
work label lacks physical units and conjugate variables
recovery lacks norm or tolerance
limitations: requires separately authorized model and protocol before execution

records.title: Immutable correction action and receipt lifecycle
records.statement: Original and corrective actions retain distinct immutable receipts with target, provenance, lifecycle, delay, residual, resource or cost, dependency, audit, and appeal references.
assumptions: correction is a later action rather than negation of history
institutional fields appear only under declared authority
records.proof_placement: Lifecycle grammar in programme review §17.1; Part VIII.3
records.example_placement: Laboratory calibration correction
prerequisites: accepted I-8 immutable artifact correction boundary
falsifiers: original receipt mutated or erased
correction represented as negative original action
prospective role asserted as an implemented I-8 type
limitations: separate future authority is required for any implementation

records.title: Correction physical and accounting closure
records.statement: A correction must declare typed stock change, boundary transfer, generation, consumption, residual, internal-transfer roll-up, and disjoint original/correction process accounts.
records.proof_placement: Closure grammar in programme review §17.2; Part VIII.3
records.example_placement: Original repair and later recalibration resource accounts
falsifiers: same transfer counted in child and parent accounts
unexplained residual forced to zero
correction inputs or losses omitted
exclusions: ledger closure as proof of isolation
limitations: closure strength is only that of the declared boundary and observability

records.title: Explicit dependency propagation
records.statement: A corrected record invalidates or recomputes reachable dependents in a declared acyclic provenance graph; smaller certified structures propagate upward only through explicit edges.
assumptions: edge inventory sufficient for unaffected claims
records.proof_placement: Programme review §17.3; Part VII.11
records.example_placement: Cold-chain calibration correction invalidating dependent route and topology summaries
falsifiers: missing edge leaves stale descendant certified
cycle prevents topological order
changed boundary incorrectly treated as same protocol
exclusions: equation of provenance DAG with Boolean upward cone
limitations: outside records are unaffected only when dependency completeness is justified

records.title: Hypergraph and Möbius accounting are noncausal
records.statement: Finite interaction coordinates locate and quantify overlapping interactions but do not prove causality, blame, fairness, entitlement, or settlement.
assumptions: finite interaction hypergraph is used only as an accounting representation
records.proof_placement: Meaning boundary in programme review §18; Part VII.12
records.example_placement: Positive shared cold-chain interaction with unresolved individual allocation
falsifiers: book text infers causality or settlement from coefficient sign alone
limitations: causal and institutional conclusions require separate evidence and rules

records.title: Temporal feedback oscillation is not a wave
records.statement: Oscillation in a declared feedback trajectory is temporal dynamical behaviour and does not reopen wave, phase, superposition, physical-interference, or voltage programmes.
assumptions: oscillation is derived from the declared feedback model
records.proof_placement: Programme review §§14–15 and §18; Part VIII.15
records.example_placement: Damped thermostat oscillation with no spatial propagation claim
falsifiers: book labels feedback oscillation as wave or interference
replacement_mapping: REMOVE:redundant wave and generic feedback outlines
limitations: a separate physical wave requires separate domain variables and authority

records.title: No implemented correction-feedback expansion
records.statement: The programme adds no I-8 or I-9 field, class, API, path, descendant traversal, physical correction receipt, controller, settlement, appeal, or fraud mechanism.
assumptions: accepted target is the controlling framework coordinate
records.proof_placement: Programme review §2.2 and §17.1; book register §§2.1 and 16.9
records.example_placement: Accepted artifact correction contrasted with prospective physical correction action
falsifiers: candidate changes a framework path
candidate claims a reserved or implemented CorrectionActionReceipt
exclusions: retrofit into accepted I-8 or I-9
limitations: future implementation requires separate authority

records.title: Visible positive interaction may incentivize cooperation
records.statement: Under declared measurement and institutional safeguards, visible positive group interaction may incentivize cooperation and reuse of certified joint structures.
assumptions: frozen comparator and complete burden account
records.proof_placement: No physical proof; protocol obligations in programme review §19.1 and Part IX.18
records.example_placement: Neighbourhood reuse of a certified shared cold chain
falsifiers: predeclared cooperation or outcome measure worsens under the institutional intervention
effect disappears under omitted-input control
harm or benefit concentration breaches the declared threshold
exclusions: equal contribution from positive group value
replacement_mapping: REPLACE:IX.18:Competition, Cooperation, Motivation, and Adaptive Preferences
limitations: institution-specific and empirically unresolved

records.title: Immutable correction and protected disclosure may improve trust and learning
records.statement: Immutable correction and early disclosure may improve trust, learning, and recovery only under declared privacy, consent, appeal, independent-audit, nonretaliation, noncausal, and fair risk-benefit rules.
records.proof_placement: No physical proof; protocol obligations in programme review §19.2 and Part IX.19
records.example_placement: Hospital sensor calibration disclosure and correction
falsifiers: predeclared trust or learning measure worsens
reporting latency increases
retaliation or privacy harm exceeds the declared threshold
correction costs or benefits are unfairly concentrated
replacement_mapping: REPLACE:IX.19:Verification, Gaming, Rebound, Missing Burdens, and Contestability
limitations: institution-specific and empirically unresolved

records.title: Conditional self-regulation capability
records.statement: Measured residuals and bounded correction may support self-regulation when the declared feedback law passes stability, delay, observability, resource, and governance tests.
assumptions: correction channel physically available and authorized
correction costs and failure states included
records.proof_placement: Conditional boundary in programme review §19.3; Part IX.19 cross-reference to Part VIII
records.example_placement: Bounded inventory correction rejected when delay margin fails
falsifiers: declared controller destabilizes the system
correction cost exceeds declared benefit
unobserved mode defeats correction
limitations: conditional design capability only

records.title: Interaction, contribution, responsibility, fairness, and settlement remain separate
records.statement: No numerical identity is presumed among interaction value, estimated individual contribution, causal responsibility, fairness, and entitlement or settlement.
assumptions: each quantity has its own declared evidence and rule
records.proof_placement: Programme review §19.4; Part IX.18 and IX.19
records.example_placement: Shared cold-chain benefit with unresolved participant allocation
falsifiers: book equates any two quantities without a separate declared rule or identified design
limitations: separate institutional rules may relate quantities but must remain explicit

records.title: Excluded optional mathematics and physical analogies
records.statement: The programme reserves no Koopman, Hodge, complex susceptibility, wave, phase, superposition, physical-interference, voltage, or universal Fibonacci/fractal route.
assumptions: no displayed result requires the excluded machinery
records.proof_placement: Programme review §§2.3 and 18; book register §§7.2, 9, and 16.9
records.example_placement: Feedback oscillation derived directly from characteristic roots
falsifiers: book reopens an excluded route through title, analogy, proof obligation, or framework proposal
replacement_mapping: REMOVE:redundant topology, wave, voltage, Fibonacci-fractal, and generic-feedback outlines
limitations: a genuinely required future method would need separate authority and proof
